$comment: What this build changed this round, shown to the judge by src/round-notes.ts. Overwrite every round: your round number and 4-5 one-liners. npm run check validates the shape.
notes: A pull now spends the whole glow and only travel earns it back - a press cannot pay for itself
The resource is a halo on the wisp: a cold blue arc while spent, a complete warm gold circle when ready
The lumen chain waits until level 3, so the opening carries one resource instead of two timers
Levels 2 and 3 are hand-authored - required routes clear every patrol, shortcut motes sit inside the gates
A press while spent is answered with a cold collapsing ring and a dead voice, not swallowed
